brief:
Hebron's relief and support committee documented a rise in the number of displaced persons in the city to 2,649, the Ma'an news agency reported. The committee tracks internal displacement within the occupied West Bank city as Palestinians flee areas of conflict or heightened military operations.

The figure reflects ongoing displacement pressures in Hebron, a city that has witnessed repeated rounds of Israeli military operations and settler violence in recent years.
title: Displacement in Hebron reaches 2,649 people, relief committee reports
